Titles.jpn: パンティ＆ストッキングwithガーターベルト

Summaries.eng:
"There lies a city on the fault line between Heaven and Hell, Daten City, where humans live under the constant threat of attack from evil spirits. Darkness invades peoples' hearts, and not one person realizes that it is consuming the city... There are those who seek to obliterate these manifestations of human desire with transcendent light. Has the duty of repelling the darkness fallen to the messengers of God or the servants of Satan?" -- 

The story centres on a teen-celebrity-like sex-crazed blonde-haired girl named Panty and a her sugar-addicted black-haired Goth Loli sister Stocking. Kicked out of heaven for their misdeeds there, these two angels now have to battle Ghosts on Earth for Heaven Coin, to pay for tickets back to Heaven. -- 

"Do the angels bring tidings of hope and light? Or do they bring despair and darkness?" Better bet on the latter!
Summaries.jpn:
ダテンシティを日々襲う怪事件。
それは人々の欲望につけこむゴーストの仕業だった！
天から遣わされた二人の天使・パンティとストッキングはゴースト退治に乗り出すが… 実は二人とも素行不良の落ちこぼれだった？ ！
黒雲渦巻くダテンシティで、災厄が災厄を呼ぶゴーストハントが今、幕を開ける！！

Aliases: NEW Panty And Stocking with Garterbelt

Summaries.eng: A special short included with the 5th DVD/BD release.

Titles.jpn: 仁義なき排泄

Summaries.eng: Panty and Stocking are sent to investigate several cases of people getting eaten by toilets, which are caused by a ghost bent on covering Daten City in feces.

Titles.jpn: デスレース2010

Summaries.eng: Panty and Stocking chase after a ghost with the ability to possess vehicles. However, Panty's underwear (which transform into her weapon) get stuck on the ghost's head, making it difficult to get them back without damaging them.

Titles.jpn: ミツバチのざわめき

Summaries.eng: While investigating a series of disappearances at Daten City High School, Panty and Stocking encounter Queen Barby, the cheerleading team captain whose reign as the most popular student is threatened by the Anarchy sisters. With the help of the teenage occult geek Brief, Panty and Stocking expose Barby as the Ghost behind the school's disappearances.

Titles.jpn: セックス・アンド・ザ・ダテンシティ

Summaries.eng: At the preview of her and Stocking's first feature film, Panty screens a pornographic film she once starred in, which leaks to the public. With her celebrity lifestyle at risk, Panty travels the world with Stocking and destroys every copy of the porn in existence save for one, which the sisters decide to keep for themselves. But when Panty reveals she edited out all of Stocking's scenes in their film, Stocking gets revenge by uploading the last porn copy online.

Titles.jpn: キャットファイト・クラブ

Summaries.eng: Panty and Stocking get into a heated argument over a missing cup of pudding and go their separate ways. However, they are forced to put their differences aside to defeat a pair of Ghosts who work as a team.

Titles.jpn: パルプ・アディクション

Summaries.eng: The Ghosts of vengeful sperm cause a shortage of tissue paper, rendering the men in Daten City incapable of wiping themselves after ejaculating.

Titles.jpn: ダイエット・シンドローム

Summaries.eng: Stocking finds herself gaining weight and goes on an intense diet, but she only keeps getting fatter until she balloons into a giant. When the cause is revealed to be from an obese Ghost who refuses to diet, Stocking sets out for revenge. Upon defeating the Ghost, Stocking returns to her original figure.

Titles.jpn: ハイスクール・ヌーディカル

Summaries.eng: Daten City High School holds a lingerie run in which participants must race in their underwear. The run is interrupted by a Ghost who eats underwear, including Panty and Stocking's weapons, so Panty must resort to using whatever underwear she can find.

Titles.jpn: ハナムプトラ

Summaries.eng: A recreational nose-picking fad spreads across Daten City thanks to a man named Oscar H. Genius, who invites the citizens of Daten City to a blimp party. However, Genius turns out to be a Ghost intent on ramming the blimp into the moon using the passengers' collective nosebleeds.

Titles.jpn: ヴォミッティング・ポイント

Summaries.eng: In the gloomy town of Little Tokyo neighboring Daten City, a struggling office worker named Terao is denied his chance to attend his young daughter's birthday party and forced by his co-workers to drink a mountain of beer, causing him to create a Ghost made of vomit. Panty and Stocking defeat the Ghost and decide to help Terao with his troubles by giving him their autographs as a present for his daughter, who is an avid fan of the Anarchy sisters.

Titles.jpn: 悪魔のような女たち

Summaries.eng: Panty and Stocking arrive at school to find that a strict academic regime has been established by the mayor's daughters, the Demon sisters Scanty and Kneesocks, and are banished to the lowest class in school. Together with Brief, Panty and Stocking discover that Scanty and Kneesocks are demons who are running a factory that produces an army of fake Ghosts beneath the school. A destructive battle ensues, with the Anarchy sisters defeating the Daemon sisters by destroying the stone that powers the factory.

Titles.jpn: トランスホーム

Summaries.eng: Panty and Stocking's sibling feud escalates into all-out war when they eat the cores of two warring alien robots and transform into robots themselves. When the alien robots decide to join forces to destroy the human race and merge into a Ghost, Panty and Stocking are once again forced to work together to defeat the Ghost.

Titles.jpn: 現金に裸体を張れ

Summaries.eng: Garterbelt gets angry at Panty and Stocking for wasting money, so the sisters make a bet to raise $3 million in three days. Getting jobs proves difficult for them, so they resort to going to a casino run by Scanty and Kneesocks, who rig their games to ensure the angels will lose. The Anarchy sisters eventually run out of money, but by selling their clothes to onlookers, they manage to play long enough to break through the Demon sisters' scheme and earn their $3 million.

Titles.jpn: …オブ・ザ・デッド

Summaries.eng: Panty and Stocking are holed up in a town where Scanty and Kneesocks have unleashed a horde of zombies that are immune to the Anarchy sisters' weapons, until they turn on the Demon sisters and turn the entire city into zombies.

Titles.jpn: 一匹の怒れるゴースト

Summaries.eng: The disguised Demon sisters put Panty and Stocking on trial for the murder of a friendly Ghost, with a monkey wearing a translation device on its head serving as the sisters' defense attorney. The sisters are found guilty and sentenced to electrocution, which jolts the monkey lawyer's translation device and grants him heightened intelligence, allowing him to prove the sisters' innocence and implicate the murdered Ghost's wife as the true culprit.

Titles.jpn: 天使が水着にきがえたら

Summaries.eng: Panty and Stocking once again face off against Scanty and Kneesocks, this time in a volleyball match to determine who will control the public beach. The Anarchy sisters win, but the Demon sisters unleash a horde of aquatic Ghosts to wreak havoc before making a getaway.

Titles.eng: Ghost: The Phantom of Daten City
Titles.jpn: ゴースト ～ダテンシティの幻～

Summaries.eng: Stocking falls in love with a repulsive and ill-mannered Ghost and is willing to forsake her duties as an angel in order to be with him. Concerned for her sister, Panty attempts to kill the Ghost, but the Ghost proves to reciprocate Stocking's feelings and proposes to her. The moment Stocking accepts, however, the Ghost finds himself at peace and ascends to Heaven.

Titles.jpn: インナーブリーフ

Summaries.eng: Panty and Stocking are shrunken down and wind up inside Brief's body where they wreak havoc.

Titles.jpn: チャック・トゥ・ザ・フューチャー

Summaries.eng: The second part is a trilogy of shorts starring Panty and Stocking's pet sidekick, Chuck.

Titles.jpn: HELP! 二人はエンジェル

Summaries.eng: The third part is a music video featuring the main characters performing "D City Rock feat. Debra Zeer".

Titles.eng: Once Upon a Time in Garterbelt
Titles.jpn: ワンス・アポン・ア・タイム・イン・ガーターベルト

Summaries.eng: Panty and Stocking suspect Garterbelt of engaging in sexual activities behind their backs and search for incriminating evidence to use against him. They instead find Garterbelt's diary, which details his past life as a crime lord before he was killed and forced by God to live through all of history until he agreed to become His missionary.

Titles.jpn: ナッシング・トゥ・ルーム

Summaries.eng: Panty and Stocking spend the entire day in their living room, discussing various things while waiting for Garterbelt to make them dinner.

Titles.jpn: D.C.コンフィデンシャル

Summaries.eng: Scanty and Kneesocks report the results of their unsuccessful battles with Panty and Stocking, as well as the whereabouts of the blood kin of Hell's Monkey, to Corset, the mayor of Daten City.

Titles.jpn: パンティ＋ブリーフ

Summaries.eng: Panty and Stocking have collected enough Heaven Coins to be allowed back into Heaven. However, only Stocking is taken back while Panty is forced to repeat her duties on Earth and forbidden to have sex as punishment for her immoral behavior. To cheer her up, Brief invites her to a party where he is to be engaged to the mayor's daughter (Scanty in disguise) and instead announces his intention to marry Panty. Scanty and Kneesocks attack Panty, who begins losing her angelic powers and escapes with Brief. Panty decides to have sex with Brief, but finds herself unable to do so as she has regained her virginity. Corset and the Demon sisters appear and kidnap Brief, the blood kin of Hell's Monkey whose penis is the key to Hell's Gate, leaving Panty powerless to save him.

Titles.jpn: ビッチガールズ

Summaries.eng: Having lost her powers, Panty is kicked out by Garterbelt and moves onto a farm with an old woman who, unbeknownst to her, is in league with Garterbelt and persuades her to stop Corset from using Brief to unlock Hell's Gate. Panty has sex with Brief, losing her virginity and restoring her powers. Stocking returns to help Panty fight Corset and the Demon sisters.

Titles.jpn: ビッチガールズ 2ビッチ

Summaries.eng: Brief accidentally unlocks Hell's Gate with his penis, unleashing a massive Ghost that begins destroying Daten City. Corset kills Garterbelt and merges with the Ghost to invade Heaven. Panty and Stocking find Garterbelt's credit card and use it to buy countless weapons from Heaven and form a massive laser with which to defeat Corset. However, they accidentally fire it backwards into the sky, though it instead summons Panty and Stocking's mother, who destroys Corset and pushes the Ghost back into Hell's Gate, which is sealed. Garterbelt returns to life to continue watching over the Anarchy sisters, who are once again kicked out of Heaven for maxing out his credit card, thus using up their Heaven Coins. Following the end credits is a string of bizarre plot twists that set up a premise for another season and baffle all the characters present.

Titles.jpn: New PANTY & STOCKING with GARTERBELT

Summaries.eng:
The Bitches Are Back!!

In Daten City, a realm between heaven and hell, sinister spirits known as "Ghosts" prowl the streets, feeding on human desires and resentment. Yet, in the darkest moments, two figures emerge to obliterate these vengeful beings with a divine light beyond human understanding. Their names? Panty & Stocking! These fallen angel sisters have been tasked with purging the darkness engulfing the earth. But who are they, really? Are they truly messengers of God... or agents of the Devil?
Summaries.ita: A Daten City, tra paradiso e inferno, dei “Fantasmi” si nutrono dei desideri e dei risentimenti degli umani. Due figure misteriose emergono per distruggerli con la luce divina: Panty e Stocking. Il compito dei due angeli caduti è purificare l’oscurità che avvolge la Terra. Ma chi sono davvero? Le ha mandate Dio o il Diavolo? In questo regno, le sorelle lottano contro forze soprannaturali.
Summaries.fra: À Daten City, entre Paradis et Enfer, de sinistres "fantômes" se nourrissent de désirs et ressentiment humains. Deux êtres mystérieux surgissent pour anéantir ces fantômes par leur lumière divine : Panty & Stocking. Les deux sœurs et anges déchus doivent débarrasser la Terre des ténèbres. Mais qui sont-elles ? Messagères de Dieu... ou agents du Chaos ?
Summaries.pt: Em Daten City, entre o Céu e o Inferno, "fantasmas" sinistros se alimentam dos desejos e ressentimentos humanos.Duas figuras misteriosas surgem para destruir esses seres com luz divina: Panty & Stocking.Essas irmãs anjos que caíram do Céu precisam dissipar as trevas que engoliram a Terra.Mas quem elas são de fato? Mensageiras de Deus ou agentes do Diabo? As irmãs enfrentam forças sobrenaturais.

Titles.jpn: パンティ アンド ストッキング ホームカミング

Summaries.eng: Continuing from the cliffhanger in the previous season, Garterbelt, Brief and Chuck team up with Scanty and Kneesocks to resurrect Panty and stop an out-of-control Stocking.
Summaries.jpn: 神と悪魔の狭間の街ダテンシティで今日も堕落した生活を送るビッチ天使姉妹のパンティとストッキング。そんな時、人々の欲望や怨念から生まれた悪霊＜ゴースト＞が平和な街に影を落とす。神父ガーターベルトの命を受け、パンティ＆ストッキングは愛車シースルーを駆り嫌々出動する！

Titles.jpn: ビッチガールズフォー・ライフ

Titles.jpn: ボディカード

Summaries.jpn: 突然、３兆ダテンシティドルの支払いを命ぜられたパンティ。天界クレカも停まり、ショッピングやパーティーにも行けず憤慨するパンティはブリーフを連れ金策に走る。

Titles.eng: Project S: The Worst Ever Dojo
Titles.jpn: プロジェクトS　史上最悪の道場

Summaries.eng: After another argument with Panty, Stocking works together with Scanty to kill a Ghost at a dojo.
Summaries.jpn:
くだらない姉妹喧嘩がきっかけでコンビの解散を宣言するストッキング。
そんな時、ガーターベルトが密かに足取りを追い続けていたゴーストの根城が判明し、パンティ＆ストッキングに潜入捜査の司令が下るのだが……。

Titles.jpn: ビッチ・パーフェクト

Summaries.eng: Daten City is experiencing an unprecedented SNS boom! Stocking is engrossed in an app that lets you earn hearts and feel good. Before I knew it, Panty and the Demon Sisters have also gotten hooked on the app...
Summaries.jpn: ダテンシティは空前SNSブーム！ハートを稼ぐと気持ちよくなれるアプリに夢中のストッキング。気づけばパンティやデイモン姉妹もアプリにハマりだし……。

Titles.jpn: F*CK & FURIOUS

Summaries.eng: On a certain afternoon, Panty was sleeping peacefully with a relaxed breathing sound. Under the bed, there was a crumpled ball of tissue paper...
Summaries.jpn: ある昼下がり、気持ちよさそうに寝息をたてながら眠っているパンティ。そのベッドの下には丸まったティッシュペーパーのかたまりが落ちていた……。

Titles.jpn: ダテンシティ・プレジデント

Summaries.eng: Stocking must win Daten City's presidential election in order to pardon Panty.
Summaries.jpn: ダテンシティで＜無許可でSEXをしたら死刑＞という新たな法律が施行され、即死刑を言い渡されたパンティを救うべく、街の大統領選挙に立候補することになったセメタリーヒルズ教会の面々。果たして誰が大統領に相応しいのか……。その時、ブリーフは閃いた！

Titles.jpn: ペット・セメタリ―ヒルズ

Summaries.eng: Panty plans to kill a cat Ghost, but soon grows affection for it.

Titles.jpn: 昨日に向って撃て！

Summaries.eng: The four girls, with the help of a strange man from space, try to kill a monolith before it destroys the universe.
Summaries.jpn: 宇宙から飛来した謎のキューブ。時を同じくしてダテンシティ上空に巧みな名古屋弁を操る謎の男が現れたのだった！

Titles.jpn: ローリングシスターズ

Summaries.eng: A sushi ghost causes a hurricane to strike Daten City while Scanty attempts to poop.
Summaries.jpn: 一週間ぶりに便意を催したスキャンティ。その時、ダテンシティには過去最大級のハリケーンが襲来していた！

Titles.jpn: ミュータントガーターベルトズ

Summaries.eng: Garterbelt takes pity on a Turtle Ghost, which later possesses his soul.
Summaries.jpn: 街でゴーストと交戦中のパンティとストッキング。とどめを刺そうとしたその時、突如現れたガーターベルトがゴーストを守る。果たしてその目的とは……。

Titles.jpn: ビッチ連続殺人！

Summaries.eng: A series of murders are happening in Daten City, the victims are blonde sexy promiscuous girls, on hands of a Murderer Ghost, and the next one in the spotlight is Panty.
Summaries.jpn:
ダテンシティで、ブロンドヘアーの女性ばかりが狙われる連続殺人事件が発生した。
警察によってセーフハウスへ移送されるパンティだが……。

Titles.jpn: 天使兄弟現わる

Summaries.eng: Panty and Stocking get replaced by their cousins, the angel brothers Polyester and Polyurethane.
Summaries.jpn: どっちの身分が上かで言い争うパンスト姉妹とデイモン姉妹。ゴーストを多く倒した方が負けた方を召使いにすると言い、街中のゴーストを片っ端から倒してゆく４人だが、突然、パンティとストッキングがゴースト退治をするのに必要な＜ヘヴンズライセンス＞が剥奪され、事態が一変する。

Titles.jpn: インデペンデンス・ディック

Summaries.eng: Garterbelt, Briefs, and Chuck finally cry out in despair at the tyranny of the Angel Sisters and Devil Sisters. Garterbelt leaves the church and heads to Casino City with Briefs to fulfill her humble dream of spending a night at Casino City's strip bar! But...
Summaries.jpn: 天使姉妹と悪魔姉妹の横暴に対して、遂に悲鳴を上げたガーターベルトとブリーフ、チャック。教会を飛び出たガーターベルトは、「カジノシティのストリップバーで一晩を過ごす」ささやかな夢を叶えるため、ブリーフたちとカジノシティを目指す！が……。

Titles.jpn: ロンゲスト・ビッチヤード

Summaries.eng: Both the Anarchy and Daemon Sisters are sent to prison and must win a game of American football for their freedom.
Summaries.jpn: ビッチ罪によりビッチ刑務所に収容されたパンティとストッキング。二人は先に刑務所に入っていたデーモン姉妹と一致団結して勝てば無罪となるビッチアメフト大会に挑む！

Titles.jpn: インターネットをやっつけろ

Summaries.eng: Impact Cop attempts to discover the root of all evil.
Summaries.jpn: ダテンシティに配属された新米刑事は、街の治安が悪くなっている理由をインターネットで調べようとするが……。

Titles.jpn: インターネットたちの沈黙

Summaries.eng: A grief-stricken Impact Cop vows to end evil once and for all.
Summaries.jpn: 警察署が壊滅した。行き場を失った新米刑事がたどり着いたのは、海の見える寂れた民宿だった。

Titles.jpn: ファ・ファ・フ*ック

Summaries.eng: Panty is barred from swearing, causing her to find a loophole.
Summaries.jpn: 息を吸うようにFワード連呼するパンティを見かねて、天界コンプライアンス委員会に通報するガーターベルト。Fワードを封じられ、言いたいことも言えなくなったパンティは……。

Titles.jpn: 大御菓子峠

Summaries.eng: Stocking is desperate to win an Ohagi Unicorn.
Summaries.jpn: ダテンシティに突如現れたアジアンスイーツショップKYOTOの限定スイーツ「おはぎユニコーン」の購入権利をかけたじゃんけん大会に挑むストッキング。果たして、その結果は!?

Titles.jpn: ノット・２・ホーム・アローン

Summaries.eng: Polyester and Polyurethane sneak into the church to find out what Panty and Stocking's weaknesses are.
Summaries.jpn: パンスト姉妹の留守を見計らってセメタリーヒルズ教会へ忍び込んだポリエステルとポリウレタン。しかし、教会の住人たちに見つかり思いも寄らない事態に！

Titles.jpn: Six hundred Sixty Six Candles

Summaries.eng: Kneesocks celebrates her birthday without her sister.
Summaries.jpn: 誕生日を忘れられ落ち込むニーソックス。そんな姿を見かねたパンティは彼女を街へ連れ出すのだった。

Titles.jpn: 遊星からの物体SEX

Titles.eng: Lord of the Kokan the Great
Titles.jpn: ロード・オブ・ザ・コカン・ザ・グレート

Summaries.jpn: 遥か文明の夜明けまえ――故郷を焼かれた戦士は復讐の旅に出る。

Titles.jpn: マルデチャックの穴

Summaries.eng: Brief falls into a deep hole and tries to escape with the help of Chuck.
Summaries.jpn: 深い穴の中で目を覚ましたブリーフは偶然居合わせたチャックと力を合わせて穴からの脱出を図ろうとするが……。

Titles.eng: Panty Shorts and the Penis of Doom

ガーターベルトの指令を受け、伝説の秘宝が眠る遺跡へとやってきたパンティたち一向。
しかし、そこに待ち受けていたのは古代の邪教による犠牲者たち怨念だった！

Summaries.jpn: 破れたホネコネコを修理しようとした瞬間、ストッキングの目の前に突然未来人が現れた。なんでも、ホネコネコを修理すると未来がとんでもない事になるらしい！そこへ更なる未来から来た存在が現れ……。

Titles.jpn: パートタイムジョブ・ビフォア・クリスマス

Summaries.eng: Kneesocks is forced to take Santa Claus' job on Christmas.
Summaries.jpn: 今日はクリスマス・イブ。ひとり平穏なホリデーを過ごすニーソックスだが、パンティの部屋から漏れる喘ぎ声に苦情を言いに乗り込むと、そこには白い髭をはやした血まみれのおじさんが横たわっていた。

Titles.eng: Heaven Wars Episode One - The Family Menace
Titles.jpn: HEAVEN WARS エピソード1 THE FAMILY MENACE

Summaries.jpn: 至急天界へ帰還する事になったパンティとストッキング。二人に連れられ一緒に天界へ行く事になった教会の面々だが、ブリーフは大好きなパンティの実家に行けるとなって大興奮！ガンスミスビッチに恋愛占いを頼むが、そこで思いもよらない結果を耳にする事に……。

Titles.eng: Heaven Wars Episode Two - Attack of the Uncle
